text:
```yaml
name: Lint ObjC New Replacement

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main, develop]
    paths:
      - '**/*.m'
      - '**/*.h'
      - '**/*.mm'
      - 'AGENTS.md'

jobs:
  replace-new:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Find and replace `[new]` with `[[alloc] init]`
        uses: jacobtomlinson/gha-find-replace@f1069b438f125e5395d1c6fd3b559a7880cb5
        with:
          include: '**/*.{m,h,mm}'
          find: '\\[\\s*([A-Za-z0-9_]+)\\s+new\\s*\\]'
          replace: '[[${1} alloc] init]'
          regex: true

      - name: Add convention rule to AGENTS.md
        run: |
          if ! grep -q "Do not use \[Class new\] in Objective-C code" AGENTS.md; then
            echo "- Do not use [Class new] in Objective-C code. Use [[Class alloc] init] instead." >> AGENTS.md
          fi

      - name: Commit changes
        uses: EndBug/add-and-commit@v9
        with:
          author_name: github-actions[bot]
          author_email: github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com
          message: "chore: replace `[new]` with `[[alloc] init]` and add convention rule"
          add: "."
          push: true
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```
